network_activity: none; no S3 or network refetch

scope.serving_precedence: flat canonical key, then mirrored nested canonical key

inputs.role: authoritative logical serving view, assignment gate result, and zone collection provenance status
corroborating lot-property audit for missing zone_code and missing assignment_method only; not used to classify zone geometry provenance
inputs.compatibility: same 897 lot collections, 3429863 lot features, and 1153807 zone_assignment_unavailable as the authoritative registry

corrected_conclusion: Absence of exact v2 zone geometry proof makes zero lots geometry-verified, but it does not erase 2276056 recorded spatial assignments. Assignment/join evidence and zone geometry provenance are separate axes.

recorded_spatial_assignment.evidence_rule: The authoritative registry reached zone_collection_not_exact_source_eligible only after finding a non-empty zone code and validating assignment_method as area-majority or centroid-fallback.

accepted_methods.meaning: zone selected from measured positive lot-zone intersection area
point-in-polygon fallback recorded when exact intersection-area computation failed

recorded_spatial_assignment.per_method_split_reason: The retained served-proof registry validates the two accepted values but aggregates both after validation into zone_collection_not_exact_source_eligible. An exact individual split would require a prohibited refetch of served lot features, so no split is invented.

no_zone_assignment.registry_rule: zone code absent or assignment_method equals unassigned
no_zone_assignment.method_presence_note: The v1 audit's 109961 missing-method cases are a subset of the no-assignment population because the authoritative registry contains no assignment_method_unavailable or assignment_method_invalid reason after its no-assignment check. The retained reports do not preserve the value distribution for the remaining 1043846 cases.

collection_shape.note: with_any_recorded_assignment and with_any_unassigned_lot overlap for mixed collections

zone_geometry_provenance.status_basis: served-proof-registry logical qc-zonage collection status, joined by exact slug to each logical qc-lots collection

exact_source_eligible.interpretation: no collection has the exact matching valid v2 collection-and-feature geometry proof required for geometry-verified

recoverable.interpretation: dedicated geometry evidence URL is recorded, but exact v2 eligibility is not established

quarantine.interpretation: collection is not fully traceable under the dedicated geometry-evidence policy

zone_collection_unavailable.causality_note: The registry evaluates no-assignment before zone-collection availability, so this is an association, not proof that collection absence caused every unassigned lot.

migration_statuses.precedence: no-zone-assignment when no recorded assignment; otherwise classify the assigned lot from its joined zone collection provenance

totals.reason: No logical zone collection is exact_source_eligible v2. Legacy or merely recoverable evidence is never promoted to verified.
Recorded spatial assignment to a zone collection classified recoverable with dedicated geometry evidence, without exact v2 verification.
Recorded spatial assignment exists, but the joined zone collection is quarantine under the dedicated geometry-evidence policy.
No recorded zone assignment; the registry reports zone_assignment_unavailable. Zone provenance does not substitute for a missing assignment.

migration_statuses.collection_count_note: Collection memberships are not mutually exclusive because one collection can contain both assigned and unassigned lots.

interpretation_limits: A recorded assignment is evidence that the served lot carries a zone code and an accepted spatial assignment method; it is not independent re-execution of the geometry operation.
Recoverable means traceable under the registry's dedicated evidence policy, not v2 verified and not necessarily current geometry.
Quarantine applies to zone geometry provenance only; it does not negate the existence of the recorded lot-zone join.
The retained registry does not preserve exact area-majority versus centroid-fallback counts, so only their exact combined validated total is reported.
No S3 object or network endpoint was fetched again for this report.
